name: k5-c
about: C and C++ in a LumaScript mod built by lumalink build (language 13, abi 9): the script calls its C through use c and extern c fn (f32, i64, bool results; a text and a bytes passed as pointer and length) and a C++20 function (a template and a constexpr struct, no exceptions, RTTI or standard library); the mod's C calls the script's export c fns (one taking a text) through lm_exports.h; the script calls an export too
